## Vancouver Weather Outlook: Mar 14–20, 2026

**Context:** I don’t have live forecast retrieval in this chat, so I’m using a practical planning view for Vancouver in mid-March: cool temperatures, frequent clouds, and a meaningful chance of rain on several days. If rain odds stay above 50% on 4+ days, plan for indoor-first weekends.

### Weather Pattern for the Week
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cloud-rain.svg

- **Typical range:** Highs around **8–12°C**, lows around **3–6°C**
- **Likely feel:** Damp, gray, and breezy at times
- **Best prep:** Waterproof shoes, compact umbrella, and a flexible indoor backup plan

### Day-by-Day Planning View
| Date | Expected Pattern | Rain Chance | Best Use |
|---|---|---:|---|
| Mar 14 | Cloudy with showers possible | 55% | Indoor sightseeing |
| Mar 15 | Steadier rain possible | 65% | Museum or gallery day |
| Mar 16 | Mixed clouds and light rain | 50% | Short outings, indoor backup |
| Mar 17 | Showers likely | 70% | Covered attractions |
| Mar 18 | Cloudy, occasional drizzle | 45% | Outdoor window if needed |
| Mar 19 | Rain returning | 60% | Indoor family or food plans |
| Mar 20 | Cloudy with a chance of showers | 50% | Keep plans flexible |

## Rain-Heavy Weekend Picks for Vancouver

If rain stays above 50% on at least four days, these are the best indoor-friendly weekend choices:

### 1) Vancouver Art Gallery
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/easel2.svg
- Strong choice for a wet afternoon in the city center
- Good for rotating exhibitions and a slow-paced visit
- Works well as a 2–3 hour plan

### 2) Science World
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/robot.svg
- Best if you want an engaging indoor activity with interactive exhibits
- Great for families, couples, or solo exploration
- Easy to pair with nearby food stops

### 3) Granville Island Public Market
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/shop.svg
- Mostly covered, so it still works well in wet weather
- Good for browsing food stalls, local crafts, and coffee breaks
- Ideal for a relaxed weekend outing without committing to outdoor plans
